item.title: Could trees developed with gene-editing technology protect Florida's citrus industry?
item.description: A bacterial infection is wiping out Florida's citrus trees. Growers hope a rootstock developed with gene-editing technology could keep the disease at bay.
item.content:encoded:
A bacterial infection is wiping out Florida's citrus trees. Growers hope a rootstock developed with gene-editing technology could keep the disease at bay.

item.title: A bad year for the crypto industry just got a lot worse
item.description: The cryptocurrency industry just suffered a major defeat in a bill they had badly wanted to get through the Senate. It's the latest setback in a terrible year for the sector.

item.title: How Jared Kushner is mixing U.S. diplomacy with his billion-dollar business
item.description: The New Yorker's Dexter Filkins says while Trump's son-in-law is a U.S. special envoy negotiating peace, he's also working on private business deals, raising billions in some of the same countries.

item.title: The Fed raises interest rates for the first time in over three years
item.description: The Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate Wednesday to combat stubborn inflation. That will make it more expensive to borrow money to buy a car or carry a balance on a credit card.

item.title: CBO says Iran war driving up inflation, puts price tag at $38 billion
item.description: Two new, independent reports show detailed looks at the costs of the war in Iran. It's led to shortages in U.S. weapons, supply chain bottlenecks and a price tag in the tens of billions of dollars.

item.title: Family income rose and poverty fell in 2025 — but safety net cuts could erase gains
item.description: An annual report from the Census Bureau shows the average family made more money in 2025 than the year before, while the official poverty rate declined. Health care coverage was little changed from 2024.
